note: Limits the server applies to every line an AI provider returns (src/stream/ai_guard.gd, contract in /mnt/project-files/tech/AI_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.md). A line that breaks a hard limit is dropped (counts as a failed call); soft limits are clamped. Authored (static) lines are never touched.
cost_note: A line is about 450 prompt tokens (persona 150, memory 150, context 100, player 50) and 60 reply tokens; at Haiku 5.5 class prices that is a small fraction of a cent. Budget per player per game day below.
